name: biocolor
description: Inline coloring for biological sequences in any file — nucleotide / amino-acid auto-detect, MSA conservation shading, FASTQ Phred quality, with muted IUPAC palettes and explicit <color>…</color> overrides.

biocolor.enabled.description: Master switch for all sequence coloring.

biocolor.autoDetect.description: Auto-detect and color nucleotide / amino-acid runs anywhere (not just inside <color> blocks). Non-sequence text is skipped.

biocolor.conservation.description: Shade aligned columns by conservation: conserved columns vivid, variable columns faded.

biocolor.colorTags.description: Dim the literal <color>/</color> override tags so they recede visually.
